parameters.name: Config
parameters.description: The configuration of the business monitoring job. The value is a JSON string. For more information about this parameter, see the following additional information about the **Config** parameter.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the business monitoring job.

parameters.name: Scenario
parameters.description:
The scenario where you want to use the business monitoring job. Valid values:

*   `USER-DEFINED`: user-defined. This is the default value.
*   `EDAS-ROLLOUT`: application release in Enterprise Distributed Application Service (EDAS)
*   `OAM-ROLLOUT`: application release based on Open Application Model (OAM)
*   `MSC-CANARY`: canary release based on Microservice Engine (MSE)

parameters.name: Sign
parameters.description: The code of the business monitoring job. This parameter is not required when you create a business monitoring job. However, this parameter is required when you update a business monitoring job.

parameters.name: SnDump
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to record business parameters to the trace marked with the coloring sign.

*   `true`
*   `false`: This is the default value.

parameters.name: SnForce
parameters.description:
Specifies whether traffic in the trace marked with the coloring sign is all collected.

*   `true`
*   `false`: This is the default value.

parameters.name: SnStat
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to count traffic based on the coloring sign.

*   `true`
*   `false`: This is the default value.

parameters.name: SnTransfer
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the coloring sign is transparently passed down to downstream application nodes in the trace.

*   `true`
*   `false`: This is the default value.

parameters.name: UpdateOption
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the operation is an update operation.

*   `true`: update
*   `false`: insert

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms apply-scenario --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --scenario USER-DEFINED --name '测试POP业务监控' --app-id b590lhguqs@28f515462f000000 --sign a9f80000 --config nameMatchType=EQUALS service=/api/pop/test filterItems=[{"opt":"==","type":"HttpHeaders","value":"123456789","key":"uid"}] operator=and rpcType=0 group={"type":"HttpRequestParameters","key":"name"} --sn-transfer false --sn-stat false --sn-dump false --sn-force false --update-option false --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
